text_block_list.text:
Heading out to the track to tidy up after 
training...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for joining me for training 
today.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Your race is coming up soon, 
Suzuka-san. I'll help out as much as you 
need!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~ To think I might get to hear 
Suzuka-san sing for the first time in a 
while~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta hurry over early and grab good 
seats...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Say, Spe-chan. How do you feel about 
your fans?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Eh, the fans, desu ka...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, when they cheer for me, it makes me 
feel like I have to give it even more of 
my all, ganbaranakya!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It makes me want to get even faster, and I 
kinda wish they'd keep cheering for me 
foreeeeever~...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
S-Sorry, I'm just... not explaining it 
very well, desu ne...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... In other words, to you, Spe-chan, 
they're an irreplaceable presence.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's it! They're an irreplaceable 
presence!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, right! Suzuka-san, what are fans to 
you?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: What fans are to me... Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
They're the ones waiting for my songs, my 
running... waiting for me at the goal 
line...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's what my beloved fans are to me... I 
think.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah~ People waiting for you, huh~... 
That sounds so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course, I'll be waiting for you 
too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Spe-chan... We're supposed to be 
rivals, you know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That may be true, but I'm still your fan, 
Suzuka-san!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Geez... But thank you, Spe-chan.
